01

More than
a boxing club.

Gears is a Community Interest Company — every penny goes back into the club and the young people it serves.

Gears Boxing Academy opened in 2024 at Kinellar Community Centre in Blackburn, Aberdeen — a club built for the village it serves.

Boxing here is a tool for growing up well. Young people walk in shy, bullied, struggling at home or at school, or living with ADHD and learning difficulties — and they walk out taller. The ring teaches them to stand their ground, and the room teaches them they belong.

Adults train alongside them: fitness, pad work, footwork and real technique, coached properly and at your pace. Whether you have never thrown a punch or you are chasing your next bout, there is a place for you on the floor.

DisciplineShow up. Work hard. Repeat.
FocusTechnique first, always.
RespectFor coaches, opponents, yourself.
ResilienceBuilt round by round.

04 · From the ring

Genesis Uprising.
Our first fight night.

In October 2026 Gears put on its first live Olympic-style boxing show — Genesis Uprising at the Dyce Aberdeen Hotel. Black tie, two-course meal, first bell at 8pm, and a room full of Blackburn behind its boxers.

That is what this club is building towards: not just training, but nights that matter — for the boxers, and for the village that raised them.

10 Oct 2026 · Dyce Aberdeen HotelBoxing ScotlandLive on JATV
